name: Create Certificate
description: Create Certificate Create an Origin CA certificate. POST /client/v4/certificates
context:
POST /client/v4/certificates
Create an Origin CA certificate. You can use an Origin CA Key as your User Service Key or an API token when calling this endpoint ([see above](#requests)).
Required: body (body)

name: Get Certificate
description: Get Certificate Get an existing Origin CA certificate by its serial number. GET /client/v4/certificates/{certificate_id}

name: List Certificates
description: List Certificates List all existing Origin CA certificates for a given zone. GET /client/v4/certificates
context:
GET /client/v4/certificates
List all existing Origin CA certificates for a given zone. You can use an Origin CA Key as your User Service Key or an API token when calling this endpoint ([see above](#requests)).
Required: zone_id (query)
Optional: page (query); per_page (query); limit (query); offset (query)

name: Revoke Certificate
description: Revoke Certificate Revoke an existing Origin CA certificate by its serial number. DELETE /client/v4/certificates/{certificate_id}
